title: Burnet Rd Development: Blight, Bonds, No Action
summary:
*   Considered classifying the 7301 Burnet Road area as "blighted" to pave the way for development incentives.
*   Discussed using special Industrial Development Bonds to fund commercial projects proposed by the Centennial Center Joint Venture.
*   Ultimately, no decision was made on scheduling public hearings for these major development plans due to a majority of elected officials being unavailable for the proposed date.
